content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a static website hosting service provided by GitHub, a web-based platform for version control and collaboration. It allows users to host their websites directly from their GitHub repositories, without the need for a traditional web hosting service. In the context of digital product sales, GitHub Pages can be used to host a store where customers can purchase and download digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and software.  The significance of GitHub Pages lies in its ability to provide a free and reliable hosting solution for digital creators, who can then use NOWPayments to process payments without relying on Stripe or other US-based payment processors. This means that creators can retain control over their products and pricing, without being subject to the fees and restrictions imposed by these platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages-based digital product store involves several key components. First, the creator sets up a GitHub repository for their store, which includes the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files necessary to display the store's contents. The repository is then connected to a NOWPayments account, which is used to process payments for digital products.  When a customer purchases a digital product, the transaction is verified by NOWPayments, which then triggers a webhook that updates the store's inventory and sends a confirmation email to the customer. The digital product is then delivered to the customer via a Cloudflare Workers script, which is triggered by the webhook. This architecture allows creators to maintain control over their products and pricing, while also providing a seamless and secure payment experience for customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The GitHub Pages-based digital product store is built for digital creators who want to sell their products online without relying on US-based payment processors. This includes creators from countries where PayPal and Stripe are blocked, as well as those who simply want to avoid the fees and restrictions imposed by these platforms.  The solution is particularly suited for creators who sell ebooks, courses, software, and other digital products, as it provides a simple and secure way to host and sell these products online. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can access all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including the GitHub Pages-based store.
Deploying a GitHub Pages-based digital product store can save creators up to 90% on payment processing fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The GitHub Pages-based digital product store relies on several key components to function. These include:  GitHub Pages for hosting the store's website and digital products NOWPayments for processing payments and verifying transactions Cloudflare Workers for delivering digital products to customers Supabase or Google Sheets for storing order information Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for storing and delivering digital products  These components work together to provide a seamless and secure payment experience for customers, while also allowing creators to maintain control over their products and pricing.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a GitHub Pages-based digital product store today, follow these steps:  Create a GitHub repository for your store and connect it to a NOWPayments account Set up a Cloudflare Workers script to deliver digital products to customers Configure Supabase or Google Sheets to store order information Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2  Shop for the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and access all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the cost of deploying a GitHub Pages-based digital product store?

The cost of deploying a GitHub Pages-based digital product store is zero, as GitHub Pages provides free hosting for static websites. However, creators must still purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Is NOWPayments the only payment processor supported by GitHub Pages?

No, NOWPayments is one of several payment processors supported by GitHub Pages. However, it is the recommended payment processor for creators who want to avoid the fees and restrictions imposed by US-based payment processors.
Can I use GitHub Pages to sell physical products?
No, GitHub Pages is designed for hosting and selling digital products only. For physical products, creators must use a different e-commerce solution.
